column1: # Standard atomic weights and most-abundant-isotope masses, used to compute molar masses.
# Source: NIST, Atomic Weights and Isotopic Compositions for All Elements (physics.nist.gov/Comp),
#   which gives the IUPAC/CIAAW standard atomic weights; interval values replaced by the IUPAC
#   conventional values (H, Li, B, C, N, O, Mg, Si, S, Cl, Br, Tl). Blank weight: no standard atomic
#   weight (no stable isotope with a characteristic terrestrial composition). Generated 2026-10-22.
# columns: symbol, Z, standard atomic weight, relative atomic mass of the most abundant isotope
